notes: Run of 2026-11-15. Three Chronicle posts queued; one, the Ferry Building restaurant story, names a building. The El Niño subscriber event and the Inner Sunset stabbing name no street address (the latter is a crime story regardless). The '100 Market' hit is page furniture, not the article's address for the building.

findings.description: The Ferry Building's former MarketBar space, empty since early 2020, reopens as Lucania, a Southern Italian restaurant, coffee bar and cocktail bar from the A16 restaurant group, after a renovation of the 3,000 sq ft space and its patio on Embarcadero Plaza; opening set for 19 November 2026.

extra.address_note: The article names the building, not a street number. The Ferry Building's page is /san-francisco/south-beach/the-embarcadero/140/ (parcel 9900274, Landmark No. 90, survey name FERRY BUILDING), so the finding is addressed to 140 The Embarcadero.
extra.alterations: renovated to the studs within the landmark's preservation limits; two restrooms added; patio metal fence replaced with a glass wall
extra.date_note: Dated by publication: the opening itself (19 Nov) is after the run.

citation.label: San Francisco Chronicle, “After six years, one of the S.F. Ferry Building’s premier restaurant spaces is coming back to life,” 14 November 2026

raw.text: this grand Ferry Building space, one of the city’s prime waterfront restaurant locations, hasn’t been open to diners since early 2020, when MarketBar closed

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/south-beach/the-embarcadero/140/ (the Ferry Building, parcel 9900274) and card at the second slot of the homepage grid. The article names the building, not a number; see extra.address_note. Occupancy story: nothing in building — the architect field is already filled and the restaurant team are tenants, not the building's makers. Dated 14 Nov by publication, since the opening (19 Nov) postdates the run.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 140 THE EMBARCADERO (neither the record nor EAS gives this street a type) → parcel 9900274; sf-parcels has blklot 9900274 active, 140–140 THE EMBARCADERO; the 2025 roll records it as industrial, built 1896.
